description: This donut chart, titled “Task Type,” visually represents the distribution of two distinct task categories within the context of generative AI’s application in journalism, as presented in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is composed of two slices, each corresponding to a specific task type. The larger, dominant slice, colored in a muted reddish-brown, represents “Article generation” and accounts for 83.2% of the total. The smaller, adjacent slice, colored in a muted olive green, represents “Headline generation” and constitutes 16.8% of the total. Both percentage values are explicitly labeled outside their respective segments, and the chart includes a central label “Task Type” to denote the subject being categorized. The segments are arranged in a descending order of size, with “Article generation” occupying the majority of the ring.
